description: This file implements a helper class 'Downloader' for handling file downloads within the PhpSpreadsheet library, including setting appropriate headers and validating files.

classes.name: Downloader
classes.description: A class to facilitate file downloading with proper HTTP headers, file validation, and type handling within PHPSpreadsheet.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a Downloader instance, validating folder and file, setting up filepath, filename, and file type.

methods.name: download
methods.description: Executes the download process by sending headers and outputting the file.

methods.name: headers
methods.description: Prepares all necessary headers before file download, including content type, disposition, cache control, and file size.

methods.name: contentType
methods.description: Sets the Content-Type header based on the file type.

methods.name: contentDisposition
methods.description: Sets the Content-Disposition header to trigger file download with the correct filename.

methods.name: cacheHeaders
methods.description: Adds cache control headers to prevent caching or define cache duration.

methods.name: fileSize
methods.description: Sets the Content-Length header to the size of the file.
